claim: The first nine months of fiscal 2026 gross profit figure for Nike was $14.5B.
summary: Insufficient evidence to verify Nike's first nine months of fiscal 2026 gross profit as $14.5B; the period ends after the knowledge cutoff.

sub_claims.text: Nike's gross profit for the first nine months of fiscal 2026 was $14.5B.
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04 predates the end of Nike's fiscal 2026 nine-month period ending Feb 2026, so the nine-month gross profit figure is not established in model knowledge.
